variant.label: Local maintenance before expansion

declaredLimits: This is a game-profile spending authority, not a statement of real local law or treasury capacity.

rendering.text: Amounts made available by this Act may be committed to maintaining existing local public roads before they are committed to new road construction. No project is selected or represented as completed by this section.
